pick.name: LinkedIn native (profile + native scheduling + post analytics)
pick.what: Post, schedule (10 min to 3 months ahead, desktop and mobile), newsletters, Live and analytics without extra tools
pick.why: Your SMB/enterprise buyers are here; Creator Mode features were folded into every profile in 2024, so all core creator tools are free
pick.free_limits: Free; scheduling cannot do group/event/job posts; Premium optional

alts.name: AuthoredUp
alts.what: Chrome extension for LinkedIn drafting, formatting preview, hooks and analytics
alts.why: Best pay-later tool once LinkedIn is a real pipeline source

alts.name: Buffer (Free)
alts.what: Scheduler (see scheduling slot) that also posts to LinkedIn
alts.why: Use when you batch-write for several networks

candidates.name: LinkedIn native
candidates.verdict: PICK: free scheduling + analytics, where buyers are

decision: LinkedIn is the main channel for B2B SMB/enterprise and services buyers, and its native scheduler and analytics are enough at the start. Add AuthoredUp only when you post several times a week and want analytics history.
details: Set profile main button to 'Follow' and add a custom link to your site.
